description: The kinds of work Nutcracker knows, each with what it returns (gives), the shapes it starts from (takes) and the shape it hands on (makes). Shapes run brief, evidence, insight, strategy, idea, platform, execution; review judges finished work. A task carries work from shape to shape and offers the next step, so one chat can run from research to the made piece. also lists what a task does beyond these. Name one in the brief when it fits ("run a Brand Scan"); otherwise describe the outcome and Nutcracker picks.
name: list_work
title: List kinds of work
